```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
game_id <- 401856883
# The game's kickoff date from the games table (plays carry no date).
game_date <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT startDate FROM games WHERE id = ?",
  params = list(as.integer(game_id))
)$startDate |>
  substr(1, 10) |>
  as.Date() |>
  format("%B %d, %Y")
teams <- collect(tbl(con, "teams"))
```

```{r}
#| label: players
# Each player's EPA contributed (the sum of the shares of the plays they were
# named on) and their average EPA per involvement, from their own side. Only
# players named at least min_inv times are ranked, so one big play cannot
# top the board. Georgia is listed first.
plays <- game_plays(con, game_id)
home <- plays$home[1]
away <- plays$away[1]
team_levels <- c(home, away)
matchup <- paste0(home, " vs ", away, ", ", game_date)
season <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT gameId, driveId, driveNumber, playNumber, period, offense, ",
    "defense, home, away, offenseScore, defenseScore, yardline, yardsToGoal, ",
    "down, distance, yardsGained, playType, playText, ppa ",
    "FROM plays WHERE season = 2026"
  )
)
fit <- game_ep_fit(season)
epa <- game_epa_model(game_scrimmage(plays), fit)
rated <- dplyr::filter(epa, !is.na(ppa))
inv <- game_involvement(con, game_id, 2026, rated, c(home, away))
players <- game_players(inv$involvement)
positions <- inv$involvement |>
  distinct(playerId, position)
min_inv <- 4L
regulars <- players |>
  filter(involvements >= min_inv) |>
  arrange(per_inv)
top <- regulars |> slice_max(per_inv, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
board <- bind_rows(
  slice_max(regulars, per_inv, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE),
  slice_min(regulars, per_inv, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE)
) |>
  left_join(positions, by = "playerId") |>
  mutate(
    lead = playerId == top$playerId,
    team = factor(team, team_levels),
    label_plain = paste0(
      sub("^.* ", "", player),
      if_else(is.na(position), "", paste0(", ", position))
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(per_inv)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(
  board,
  aes(per_inv, reorder(label_plain, per_inv), fill = team, alpha = lead)
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>",
        label,
        "</b> (",
        team,
        ")<br>",
        round(per_inv, 2),
        " EPA per involvement over ",
        involvements,
        " involvements<br>",
        round(epa, 2),
        " EPA contributed"
      ),
      data_id = playerId
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.5), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_team(teams, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "EPA per involvement, highest and lowest",
    subtitle = paste0(
      matchup,
      "; five highest and five lowest among players named at least ",
      min_inv,
      " times"
    ),
    x = "EPA per involvement",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "game-players-named-on-valuable-plays", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: explore
# Every involvement of the players on the board, in game order: each dot is one
# play a player was named on, colored by the play's EPA from the player's side.
timeline <- inv$involvement |>
  filter(playerId %in% board$playerId) |>
  mutate(
    team = factor(team, team_levels),
    row_lab = factor(label, levels = board$label),
    tip = paste0(
      "<b>",
      label,
      "</b> (",
      team,
      ")<br>Q",
      period,
      ", ",
      roles,
      "<br>",
      playText,
      "<br>Play EPA for ",
      team,
      ": ",
      round(epa_side, 2)
    )
  )
p_timeline <- ggplot(timeline, aes(seq, row_lab)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(fill = epa_side, tooltip = tip, data_id = id),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.6,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2563eb",
    mid = "#f5f5f4",
    high = "#ea580c",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-3, 3),
    oob = scales::squish,
    breaks = c(-3, 0, 3),
    labels = c("-3 or less", "0", "3 or more"),
    name = "Play EPA for the player's side  ",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = unit(14, "lines"))
  ) +
  facet_grid(team ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  labs(
    x = "Play in game order",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Every involvement of the ranked players, in game order",
    subtitle = matchup
  ) +
  theme_card(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.placement = "outside")
card_interactive(p_timeline, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 9)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
board |>
  arrange(desc(per_inv)) |>
  transmute(
    Player = label,
    Team = as.character(team),
    Involvements = involvements,
    `EPA contributed` = round(epa, 2),
    `EPA per involvement` = round(per_inv, 2)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Player", "Team", "Involvements", "EPA contributed", "EPA per involvement"),
    caption = "The players on the board, with the EPA their plays were credited with and their average EPA per involvement."
  )
```
